title: N/E/S/A/C is a research trajectory model, not validated doctrine
claim: The N/E/S/A/C framing represents a project-level hypothesis in which natal structure, temporal environment, acquired state, action and external context jointly shape possible trajectories; it is not a canonical Zhongzhou rule or an empirically validated predictor.
maturity_note: Recorded as project rationale in the accepted historical archive and reflected in the Product future workplan. The full model's empirical validity is not established.
wording_ceiling: Describe it as a research/product modeling hypothesis or conditional scenario framework, not a discovered law of destiny or causal intervention model.
limitations: No empirical predictive increment is established by the cited artifacts.
Action effects must not be described causally without identification.
